title: Range sum query (immutable)
statement:
Implement a class NumArray: the constructor takes an integer array; sum_range(i, j) returns the sum of elements i through j inclusive. Many queries follow one construction.

Tests call the constructor, then methods; the expected outputs list null for the constructor.
hints: Precompute once so each query is O(1).
prefix[k] = sum of the first k elements; a range sum is a difference of two prefixes.

solution.explanation: Store prefix sums with prefix[0] = 0; sum_range(i, j) = prefix[j + 1] − prefix[i]. The extra leading 0 removes the i = 0 special case.
